headline: B200 leads weekly gains at +14% as GPU rental prices firm across most models.
bullets: B200 market index stands at $7.99 after a +14% move over 7 days, the largest gain in the set, with hyperscalers at $14.12 versus $7.99 at neoclouds.
H100 SXM carries the widest hyperscaler premium at +162%, with the hyperscaler median at $10.68 against a neocloud median of $4.07 and a market index of $4.32, up +7% over 7 days.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $2.64 per PFLOP-hour, with its index flat at +0% and RunPod Community Cloud listing at $0.50.
H200 rose +5% to a $5.40 index, and A100 80GB SXM also rose +5% to $2.70, while L40S held at +0% with a $1.50 index.
RunPod Community Cloud is the cheapest provider for B200, H200, H100 SXM and MI300X, while Vast.ai is cheapest for A100 80GB SXM at $0.94 and L40S at $0.54.
watch: Whether B200 momentum continues from its $7.99 index, given that its +14% weekly rise outpaces every other GPU tracked.
